# learning-angular

交互式中文 Angular 学习站（课程 + Demo + 测验 + 工坊）。姊妹项目 learning-vue3。

> 权威 API 与完整规范以官方为准：https://angular.dev/llms.txt

## Site

- [首页课程大纲](/learning-angular/)
- [文档地图（对照官网）](/learning-angular/docs)
- [代码演练场](/learning-angular/playground)
- [全栈工坊](/learning-angular/studio)
- [速查表](/learning-angular/cheatsheet)
- [学习中心](/learning-angular/hub)

## Curriculum tracks

- 基础：intro, install-cli, template, reactivity, computed, list-render, events, forms, components, props-emits, lifecycle, composition, pipes, selectors-styling
- 进阶：router, pinia, pitfalls, project, model-inputs, template-let, rxjs-interop
- 全栈准备：slots, provide-inject, async-data, route-guards, form-validate
- 全栈实训：rest-api, auth-token, nuxt-map, capstone, ssr-hydration
- 工程化：angular-ts, api-client, testing-vue, deploy-prod, security, i18n, style-guide
- 进阶模式：teleport, keep-alive, custom-directive, perf-patterns, interview-vue, defer-loading, linked-signal, resource-api, signal-forms, zoneless, animations-css
